title: Quant Market Brief — October 30, 2026: Tail-Risk Evidence & Tech Selloff

stories.headline: Unified training puts model stages under one algorithm
stories.fact: A preprint reformulates suitable RL objectives as likelihood fitting and combines static data with RL generations in one trainer. The authors report improved accuracy–compute tradeoffs in their experiments.
stories.inference: Data composition and scheduling become central experimental choices.
stories.uncertainty: Foundation-model results do not establish a benefit for a financial policy or a MATLAB implementation.
stories.why: Test fixed data-mixture schedules against staged training at matched compute.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Song et al., arXiv:2610.40564v1; October 29, 2026.
stories.alt: Two evidence panels: Static training data; RL-generated targets: shared trainer. Source and date captioned; conceptual summary, not a calibrated model.

stories.headline: Tail-forecast comparisons depend on exceedances
stories.fact: A preprint identifies exceedances as the effective sample size for comparing tail forecasts. It shows that scarce exceedances can distort standard Diebold–Mariano comparisons and studies alternative inference procedures.
stories.inference: Long backtests may still contain little evidence about extreme losses.
stories.uncertainty: Theoretical conditions and the selected score matter; changing a test alone does not validate a risk model.
stories.why: Report exceedance counts, uncertainty and sensitivity before ranking tail forecasts.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Coelho, arXiv:2610.40366v1; October 29, 2026.
stories.alt: Two evidence panels: Calendar observations; Tail exceedances: effective evidence. Source and date captioned; conceptual summary, not a calibrated model.

stories.headline: Nasdaq futures fall more than 2% before the open
stories.date: Reuters October 30; 4:04 a.m. ET / 3:04 CT snapshot
stories.fact: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 E-minis -2.16%, S&P 500 E-minis -1.00% and Dow E-minis -0.05% at 4:04 a.m. ET, with technology under pressure.
stories.inference: Concentrated technology exposure can create opening gaps beyond broad-index risk estimates.
stories.uncertainty: This early snapshot is not a live quote, spread or depth measurement.
stories.why: Reprice QQQ and SPY opening-risk assumptions using fresh quotes and auction data.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Reuters via MarketScreener; October 30, 2026, 4:04 a.m. ET.
stories.alt: Zero-centered bars show Nasdaq-100 futures -2.16%, S&P 500 -1.00% and Dow -0.05% at 3:04 a.m. CT October 30; reported snapshot.

stories.headline: September PCE inflation rises to 3.6% year over year
stories.date: BEA release October 29; September reference month
stories.fact: September PCE inflation was 3.6% year over year and 0.5% month over month. Core PCE rose 3.1% year over year and 0.3% monthly; real spending increased less than 0.1%.
stories.inference: Separate nominal spending growth from inflation-adjusted demand.
stories.uncertainty: The release is revisable and does not determine the next Fed decision.
stories.why: Preserve release vintages and model headline, core and real spending separately.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; U.S. BEA, Personal Income and Outlays; October 29, 2026.
stories.alt: Zero-based bars compare September PCE inflation: headline 3.6% and core 3.1% year over year; units percent.

stories.headline: Amazon cloud growth accompanies negative free cash flow
stories.date: Company release October 29; quarter ended September 30
stories.fact: Amazon reported AWS sales of $46.0 billion, up 39%, and a trailing-twelve-month free-cash-flow outflow of $42.4 billion, versus a $14.8 billion inflow a year earlier.
stories.inference: Operating growth and infrastructure cash requirements need separate valuation scenarios.
stories.uncertainty: Quarterly AWS revenue and trailing-year free cash flow use different periods; free cash flow is not net income.
stories.why: Compare cash generation, investment commitments and financing needs without mixing periods.
stories.credit: Market State Lab; Amazon Q3 2026 earnings release; October 29, 2026.
stories.alt: Zero-centered bars show Amazon trailing-twelve-month free cash flow: 14.8 billion inflow in September 2025 and 42.4 billion outflow in September 2026; U.S. dollars.
